BiblicalUsage: Zabud the priest was the king's friend in Solomon's court, and Hushai the Archite was David's friend who stayed loyal when Absalom rose against him. Proverbs adds the proverb: better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that a true friend is proved in the hour when loyalty costs something.
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; Hushai the Archite
